description:
Swipe into orbit. Explore the stars.

Star Stream is a colorful arcade space game where each swipe sends your rocket toward the next planet. Learn to time your launches, dodge asteroids, collect stars, and travel through new galaxies before your battery runs out.

• Swipe-based flight and orbital movement
• Missions with earned-star rewards
• Unlockable spaceships, trails, perks, and upgrades
• Local high scores and saved progress
• Landscape play on iPhone and iPad
• Offline gameplay with no account required

All unlocks use stars earned through play. No ads or in-app purchases.
promotionalText: Launch from planet to planet, collect stars, and unlock your next adventure. A classic space arcade game, revived for iPhone and iPad.
